content.text: Ugh, it looks like fcrepo-module-auth-webac depends on artifacts/classes from fcrepo-module-auth-rbacl.  So we need to bump its version, then get rid of it later.
FYI travis builds will fail until 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT artifacts of dependencies are available.  So start with fcrepo4, and fan out from there.  Re-run failing builds to pull in newly available deps
Update master branch of relevant modules from 4.8-SNAPSHOT to 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT

Ugh, it looks like fcrepo-module-auth-webac depends on artifacts/classes from fcrepo-module-auth-rbacl.  So we need to bump its version, then get rid of it later.
